name: tradeagnt
repo_role: Modular monolith: local strategies + TUI + Pi Extension. v2-base: E2 read-only + E3 paper trading + E3 backtest, all fail-closed.

command_risk_classes.local_readonly: Reads local DB/SQLite and in-process providers only.
command_risk_classes.network_readonly: Fetches public market data via configured providers.
command_risk_classes.paper_runtime_write: Local paper trading only via tradecat agent submit-thesis (fail-closed gates).
command_risk_classes.strategy_file_write: Writes local strategy YAML candidates under config/strategies only; no live orders. Activation is explicit and release-based.

extension_tools.name: trade_submit_thesis
extension_tools.description: Submit agent_trade_thesis.v1 through 5 fail-closed gates to local paper engine.

extension_tools.name: trade_paper_report
extension_tools.description: Paper account NAV, positions, and recent agent thesis rejections.

extension_tools.name: trade_run_backtest
extension_tools.description: Run a strategy backtest via tradecat backtest CLI; returns structured JSON summary.

extension_tools.name: trade_feedback_pack
extension_tools.description: Build a read-only feedback pack from paper audit, paper report, and recent signal history. Does not submit orders or write strategies.

extension_tools.name: trade_strategy_manage
extension_tools.description: Safely read, validate, write, snapshot, and activate local strategy YAML files. Writes are constrained to config/strategies; use activation is explicit.

extension_tools.name: trade_strategy_compare
extension_tools.description: Compare a baseline plus candidate strategy YAMLs through structured backtests and return ranking, winner, and rejected reasons. Does not activate strategies.

extension_tools.name: trade_strategy_evolve
extension_tools.description: Dry-run strategy loop controller: generate 2-3 local candidate YAMLs, validate/write them, run compare, and recommend a winner without changing current.

preferred_readonly_entrypoints.description: Bundle quotes, signals, news, backtest health for one symbol.

safety_boundary: E2 read-only observe tools; E3 paper via trade_submit_thesis only (local paper, fail-closed). E3-BACKTEST via trade_run_backtest (local, no live orders). No Binance signed requests.
